# Ny vd i Volvo Cars: ”Låter som ett otroligt kompetent val”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon covers a positive market open driven by US-China trade progress, Volvo Cars' external CEO appointment (Klaus Zellmer from Skoda), and a week of four small-cap IPOs in Stockholm (Axvik, Svevik, Dormi, Linjemontage) in which little new money is being raised. Other topics were Q4 seasonality, which usually favours the market, Novo's capital markets day, BONESUPPORT short-seller scepticism, the SBB–PPI property deal, low expectations ahead of H&M's report, and a bullish analyst view on Adidas.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host says Volvo Cars is uninvestable. It is effectively a Geely subsidiary, Geely comes first, and cash won't be taken out of Volvo.

#### Reasoning

Geely owns about 80% and development is steered toward Geely platforms. Shareholders are not prioritised, the industry is tough, the move to EVs and Chinese competition are problems, and past external CEOs failed. The new CEO is seen as competent but inherits a ready-made agenda.

#### Sell Triggers

- if governance changes to prioritize minority shareholders
- if new CEO delivers margin turnaround

> *"För mig är det oinvesterbart egentligen."*

---

### ⛔ DORMI — Dormi | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Guest concluded one should not subscribe to the IPO. Only the owner is selling and the company is in the narrow golf niche.

#### Reasoning

No new capital is being raised, so the listing is driven by the owner's exit. The company is well positioned but the niche is narrow. Another host said to wait and see on the stock.

#### Sell Triggers

- if listing trades well below value creating attractive entry

> *"Dormi där jag landade i att man inte skulle teckna."*

---

### 🟢 AXVIK — Axvik | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host would put money on Axvik on listing day: defense exposure, high growth and margins. Oversubscribed, but opened slightly below its subscription price.

#### Reasoning

Defense and aerospace composites benefit from European defense spending of 3% of GDP and long aircraft order books. The offer was oversubscribed, but little new money is raised and early trading was flat against a rising market.

#### Sell Triggers

- if trading stays below subscription price
- if defense spending momentum fades

> *"Jag hade satt mina pengar på Axvik på noteringsdagen."*

---

### 🟠 LINJE — Linjemontage | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Timely grid-expansion theme and could be a winner in a strong market. Indian owners keep 70%, so overhang is a risk.

#### Reasoning

The theme is attractive but the company was assembled quickly as a capital-built model. Owners selling 30% while keeping 70% raises an overhang concern, and a guest expects a weaker end to the week.

#### Sell Triggers

- if major owner sells further
- if IPO hype fades

> *"Men skulle kunna bli en vinnare om man lyckas fånga hypen i en stark marknad."*

---

### 🟢 ADS — Adidas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest wrote an analysis saying the stock looks very interesting: growth across all areas and markets at about 11x EV/EBIT next year.

#### Reasoning

Adidas grows in all product areas and markets and is strong in China while Nike struggles. Valuation of about 11x next year's EV/EBIT. Europe grew only 6% in the first half, boosted by the World Cup.

#### Sell Triggers

- if European growth stalls further
- if China momentum reverses

> *"Så den aktien tycker jag ser väldigt intressant ut."*

---

### 🟠 NKE — Nike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Falling knife, down about 70%, with a structured turnaround and over 4% dividend yield. Exciting but hard to judge.

#### Reasoning

Host frames Nike as a speculative turnaround. The depressed valuation is reflected in a high US dividend yield and the brand still has a creative soul. Weak in China, and others are bearish.

#### Sell Triggers

- if turnaround stalls
- if dividend cut

> *"Om man vill ta risk på en fallande kniv så är det ett bolag som har tappat enormt mycket"*

---

### 🟠 HM-B — H&M | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Report due Thursday. The German market is tough and expectations are depressed, which may be the biggest short-term asset. Only 3 of over 30 analysts say buy.

#### Reasoning

Weak German apparel data and negative comments from peers point to a soft report. H&M has lifted margins but not growth, and a stronger krona is a headwind. Low expectations could limit the downside.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Q3 sales in Germany weaken further
- if margin gains reverse

> *"förväntningarna är lågt ställda"*

---

### 🟠 BONEX — BONESUPPORT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Heavily shorted after a Danish study questioned how its antibiotic is released. Company says the study is flawed. All covering analysts say buy. Hosts find it too hard to judge.

#### Reasoning

Binary case: if the company's claims hold, there is large upside, and if not, its premium pricing is undermined. FDA hesitancy adds uncertainty. Hosts express no view of their own, while cited analysts are unanimously buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if FDA rejects Cerament V
- if release-duration data confirms short-seller thesis

> *"Så om vi litar på Boe Support så har man nog en stor uppsida framåt och vice versa."*

---

### 🟠 NIBE-B — Nibe | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

German heat pump subsidy applications topped 43,000 in August, up 100% year on year. Stock up 2%.

#### Reasoning

Positive German demand data for heat pumps supports a Nibe recovery. Only a data point, with no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German subsidy momentum reverses

> *"Det är en ökning med 100 procent jämfört med motsvarande månad året innan."*
